assembly_notes: Install and secure the PCB, trigger switch, charging interface, motor, and battery pack; route and strain-relieve wiring clear of moving and hot components.
Use controlled screw-driving torque and verify shell mating, boss engagement, and connector seating without damaging molded bosses.

Perform electrical safety checks and functional testing of trigger operation, charging, battery protection, and motor operation; run a motor spin or burn-in test and check for abnormal noise or overheating.
Handle cells with short-circuit protection and pack protection in place; ship battery packs by sea only as UN3481 packed with equipment.
